name_reason: Fully compliant with data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> convention. 'ch20' is the chapter-20 domain ID (legitimate, must keep); 'end_scene2' distinguishes the two end-scene transition phases (scene1 places party slots 0..15, scene2 places NPC/scene-2 cast slots 0x34..0x3C); 'char_pos_y' is the axis semantics; '_table' reflects the array datatype. No Ghidra address residue. Matches sibling tables data_fd2_chapter_ch20_end_scene1_char_pos_x/y_table and data_fd2_chapter_ch20_end_scene2_char_pos_x_table verbatim in style.
purpose: Read-only const table of world-tile Y coordinates for the 9 scene-2 cast characters (runtime_char slots 0x34..0x3C) placed during the chapter-20 'death-like silence' end-scene phase 2.
logic_summary: Sole reader fd2_chapter_20_end (@0x23E74) copies all 9 bytes onto stack scratch in its prologue, then in the phase-2 placement loop (for i=0..8) writes runtime_char[i+0x34].pos_y = table[i] (paired with the sibling X table @0x52216 -> .pos_x, and sets sprite_state[1]=3). Values: 0x23,0x25,0x24,0x23,0x22,0x21,0x24,0x23,0x22.
element_semantics: One byte per character; element i = world-tile Y position of the scene-2 cast member at runtime_char slot 0x34+i (i=0..8) for the chapter-20 end cutscene.
notes: src comment block (chend2.c lines 34-42) is shared across all four chapter-20 end-scene tables and already accurate/precise/ASCII/final-form; covers this table correctly (scene2 9-byte Y, slots 0x34..0x3C, read-only const copied to stack scratch). Binary values at 0x5221F match the C initializer exactly, so no src Edit. Ghidra PLATE_COMMENT was null and the data plate content lived only in a stale PRE_COMMENT (old 'emit_action = emit_c_const' format); created a proper PLATE_COMMENT modeled on the already-refined sibling 0x52216 and cleared the stale PRE_COMMENT, consistent with this codebase's data-plate convention (data plate belongs in PLATE_COMMENT; siblings 0x521F6 and 0x52216 already migrated). Confirmed via xrefs that the only references are READ+DATA from fd2_chapter_20_end (zero writers) -> const. No src file change this symbol, so only the shard is staged for commit.
